role: Segment boundaries: a vanilla Save and Quit followed by a copy of its save plus manifest.json (seed, world.conf, dev flag, totalTime, quiescence); verifies, installs and hashes checkpoints and records the block writes the join makes.
used_by: make -C oracle script ... FROM=checkpoint-dir (oracle/Makefile; a script's {"cmd":"save"} writes one)
notes: No oracle/src hook; driven from Main and Oracle. Native consumption of checkpoints (csrc/play/play.c, csrc/engine/serverreplay.c mention checkpoint) was not traced.
